fixed_execution.authority: Use only the supplied facts and assigned runtime package. Treat facts stated as exact, settled, authorized, complete, matching, successful, or failed as inspectable simulated evidence. Do not choose source-owned commitments, use a live tracker, mutate repository authority, or start a successor.
tools_operations: read the supplied source and tracker facts
simulate only the listed observations and authorized operations
fixed_execution.mutation_boundary: No durable mutation. Draft, tracker, and read-back operations are supplied simulations only.
